profile.headline: Software Engineer at Mass Tort Strategies, inc.
profile.summary:
My journey started back in 2010 when I first created my first "Hello World" using a notepad (HTML) in high school. In college, I wanted to expand my knowledge and I went on the route of creating my own projects. Outside the projects that I run on my GitHub, I'm an outdoors person. I like to go surfing and snowboarding in the winter. I also like coffee and spending time with my wife and my dog Rudy!

W: https://nestorjgc.com/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Laguna Hills, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · jQuery · AJAX · Microsoft SQL Server · Adobe ColdFusion

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Build from scratch and currently maintain the company's website. Their application was made with Angular/MDB. Hosted and deployed with Firebase. AWS contact form and Google Maps API for location. Gallery with Instagram API.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
• Troubleshooting computer hardware and software, such as HDD & SOD'S wipes and OS installments with USB Bootables to troubleshoot the hardware and test motherboards, RAM, graphics cards, processors, and power supplies.
 • Developed and implemented HTML code that improved upon the overall appearance and user experience of the company's eBay listings.
 • Trained employees in inspecting and troubleshooting electronics
